ValidationRule.description: R-VG3: an hours entry names a job or a shift. A row the platform emptied when its job was deleted is left alone until somebody changes the job or the shift.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(Volunteer_Job__c), ISBLANK(Volunteer_Shift__c), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Volunteer_Job__c), ISCHANGED(Volunteer_Shift__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Choose the volunteer job or the shift these hours were given to.
